name: Southard Estate Planning
tagline: Your estate plan is about your family.

hero.alt: White water lily blooming among lily pads on a Long Island pond

maps: Southard Estate Planning, 175 Main St Suite 5, Setauket, NY 11733
facts: Meet in person, by phone or video
intro: Katherine A. Southard, Esq. helps individuals and families build estate plans around their real lives: family relationships, health care wishes, assets and children. Her goal is to make estate planning accessible to everyone, regardless of net worth, with a clear plan you understand and feel confident in.

services.d: Decide who makes decisions, keep your affairs private and help your family avoid probate.
Choose who handles your financial decisions if you cannot.
Health care directives, living wills and HIPAA releases.
Name who would care for your kids if something happens.
Guidance for families settling a loved one's estate.

why.d: Each plan is customized to your family's dynamics and needs.
She explains what every document means and why it matters.
A private client portal plus in-person, phone or video meetings.
Plans are reviewed over time, with a team of experts when needed.
